content.content: Undo with pos == 0 refuses the invocation, naming that no operation exists.
content.rationale: The linear history (kpptprql) has no applied marker before position zero, which selection cannot supply; fixing the refusal with its cause keeps the case actionable per the refusal line without teaching selection about rendering. The empty stack is the zero-marker case of the same condition. The trigger matches undoEmpty's guard.
